title: Equivalent formula repairs are rejected by undocumented exact-string requirements
evidence: The task asks for an accurate, maintainable audit repair without prescribing exact formula text. Nevertheless, spec.yaml selects mode='formula', and the verifier compares formula strings after only limited normalization. For DCF!J6, the golden formula is ='Operating Model'!S32*(1+DCF!J5)/(DCF!J4-DCF!J5). The identical calculation ='Operating Model'!S32*(1+J5)/(J4-J5), differing only by omission of redundant same-sheet qualifiers, is rejected. Likewise, replacing Comps + Beta!C30 with =SUM(K22:K26)/COUNT(K22:K26) instead of =AVERAGE(K22:K26) is rejected despite equivalent behavior on these numeric inputs. Both rejections were confirmed against the comparison function. Every modification cell must match, so either harmless alternative causes the sole, weight-1 verifier to award zero.
confirmation: Verified by re-scoring the run outputs: DCF!J6 "='Operating Model'!S32*(1+J5)/(J4-J5)" is flagged 'Modification error' against the GT's DCF!-qualified version. Under _formulas_match, =SUM(K22:K26)/COUNT(K22:K26) would likewise fail against =AVERAGE(K22:K26).
fix: Same J6 GT patch (the confirmed rejection). Partial: =SUM(K22:K26)/COUNT(K22:K26) for Comps + Beta!C30 would still fail against =AVERAGE(K22:K26) (verifier-code limitation).

title: Grader compares formula text exactly with all-or-nothing scoring, so correct fixes written differently score 0
evidence: spec.yaml runs verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells with mode: formula, weight 1 (the only verifier). In formula mode, _formulas_match only removes '$', uppercases and turns '=+' into '='. It then requires the formula strings to be identical, and the task passes only if 100% of changed cells match. The golden workbook changes 8 cells. Several have equivalent fixes that would fail: (a) Supporting Schedules!N98 golden is "=N96/'Revenue Build'!J33". The row's own pattern (F98:J98) is "=1/'Operating Model'!F4*'Supporting Schedules'!F96" and "=1/'IS Q'!F18*J96". An agent that copies the pattern, e.g. "=1/'Revenue Build'!J33*N96", gets the same value (0.4576) and fails. (b) DCF!J6 golden is "='Operating Model'!S32*(1+DCF!J5)/(DCF!J4-DCF!J5)". Writing J5/J4 without the sheet name, adding brackets, or putting the terms in another order all give the same value (about 3905.6) and fail. (c) DCF!E4 golden is '=WACC!C25'. '=J4', which follows the same block's convention (J10 '=E10', J11 '=E11'), gives the same value and fails. (d) DCF!E11 golden is '=BS!N20' (926). "='BS Ann'!F20" is the same Sep-28-2025 'Total Cash & ST Investments' value of 926 and fails. One mismatch in any of these sets the whole task to 0.
confirmation: Formula-mode grading needs exact text after minimal normalization on 7 modification cells, all-or-nothing. A value-identical DCF!J6 without the 'DCF!' prefix failed in every trial, and N98 accepts only "=N96/'Revenue Build'!J33".
fix: Same J6 GT patch. Partial: E4 (=J4 vs =WACC!C25), N98 and E11 alternatives still need the key's exact text (verifier-code limitation).

title: Broad open-ended audit prompt conflicts with golden workbook that leaves dozens of genuine formula, #NAME?, and hardcode bugs unfixed
evidence: In `problem.py`, the instruction asks the agent to: "Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors, inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues that could affect accuracy or maintainability." However, `gt_06_golden.xlsx` only modifies 7 cells relative to `untouched_input_Embedded Hardcodes_input.xlsx` and grades all other 13,427 cells in `answer_position` as regression cells (requiring >= 99.8% match, i.e., at most 26 changed cells). Meanwhile, `gt_06_golden.xlsx` leaves numerous genuine bugs unfixed inside `answer_position` that directly match the prompt's error categories: (1) `Revenue Build!AC41` and `AC43` contain `=rri(5,W41,AA41)` and `=rri(5,W43,AA43)` without `_xlfn.`, evaluating to `#NAME?` (all 3 units fixed these to `=(AA41/W41)^(1/5)-1` and `=(AA43/W43)^(1/5)-1` and were penalized with Regression errors); (2) `Revenue Build!S9` is `=S13` while `J9:R9` are `=SUM(J13,J21)`..`=SUM(R13,R21)` (all 3 units fixed `S9` to `=SUM(S13,S21)` and got Regression errors); (3) `Revenue Build!F21` is `=F9` (while `G21:I21` are `=G9-G13`..`=I9-I13`) and `R17:S17` are hardcoded `0.02` (while `J17:Q17` are `=J18-0.02`..`=Q18-0.02`); (4) `Operating Model!J25:L25` (`(-) Income Taxes`) have positive `=IF(J23>0,$D$26*J23,0)` while `M25:S25` have negative `=-IF(M23>0,$D$26*M23,0)` (Unit 3 fixed `J25:L25` and got Regression errors); (5) `Operating Model!F20` is `='IS Ann'!C28` while `G20:I20` are `='IS Ann'!D29:F29` (Unit 1 fixed `F20:I20` and got Regression errors); (6) `DCF!M19`, `M37`, `T30` and the 338 sensitivity table cells `DCF!N13:Z25` and `DCF!N31:Z43` are hardcoded floats computed from the pre-fix WACC (`0.1648`) (Units 1 and 2 converted the sensitivity tables to formulas, causing 338+ Regression errors and dropping their regression ratios to `0.9646` and `0.9613`); (7) `Supporting Schedules!E60` (`=4039.6/E56`), `Supporting Schedules!K20,M20,O20,Q20,S20` (hardcoded `264`), `Supporting Schedules!O76:Y76` (referencing Base row 80 instead of active case row 77), `DCF!E23,J23`, and `PTA!R22:R39` also contain unfixed formula/hardcode errors in `gt_06_golden.xlsx`.
confirmation: GT changes only 7 cells and keeps real bugs in graded ranges: Revenue Build!AC41/AC43 '=rri(...)' (#NAME?), S9 '=S13' vs the SUM pattern, and Operating Model J25:L25 missing the minus sign. Run outputs fixing these got regression errors, and the two broader audits fell to regression 0.9646/0.9613 (<
fix: Sensitivity grids N13:Z25 and N31:Z43 stay out of answer_position (stale hardcodes with no single rebuild). gt_06_golden.xlsx now also fixes the errors QA named, on top of the 7 planted hardcode fixes and the earlier J6 change (formula mode, so the key's formula text is graded; cached values refreshed from the verifier's LibreOffice recalc, 245 cells, because the active Bear case picks up R17:S17): 'Revenue Build'!S9 =S13 -> =SUM(S13,S21) like J9:R9; F21 =F9 -> =F9-F13 like G21:I21; Bear growth R17:S17 hardcoded 0.02 -> =R18-0.02, =S18-0.02 like J17:Q17; 'Operating Model'!J25:L25 =IF(...) -> =-IF(J23>0,$D$26*J23,0) with the minus sign of M25:S25; F20 ='IS Ann'!C28 (goodwill amortisation) -> ='IS Ann'!C29 (Other Operating Expense, the row G20:I20 use); 'Supporting Schedules'!K20 hardcoded 264 -> =J20; O76:Y76 now use the active-case utilisation O77:Y77 like N76 (were Base row O80:Y80). 'Revenue Build'!AC41/AC43 =rri(...) (#NAME?) are now =_xlfn.RRI(5,W41,AA41) / =_xlfn.RRI(5,W43,AA43) (0.3797 / 0.7188) in the key, but leave answer_position: a plain =RRI( written by openpyxl and the prefixed form are different texts for the same repair. title: Formula-mode verifier performs brittle raw-string comparison that rejects equivalent formulas on target modification cells
evidence: The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight: 1) runs with `mode: formula` and requires `mod_ratio == 1.0` across all 7 modification cells (`DCF!E4`, `DCF!E5`, `DCF!E11`, `DCF!J6`, `WACC!C8`, `Supporting Schedules!N98`, `Comps + Beta!C30`) to award a non-zero score. In `verifiers/spreadsheetbench2.py`, `_formulas_match` checks `_normalize_formula(f1) == _normalize_formula(f2)`, where `_normalize_formula` only strips `$`, converts to uppercase, and strips a leading `+` after `=`. However, the golden workbook `gt_06_golden.xlsx` uses non-canonical or non-unique formula syntax in multiple modification cells: (1) In `DCF!J6` (on the `DCF` sheet), `gt_06_golden.xlsx` has `='Operating Model'!S32*(1+DCF!J5)/(DCF!J4-DCF!J5)` with redundant same-sheet `DCF!` prefixes on `J5` and `J4` (contradicting `DCF!J7` right below it: `=J6/(1+J4)^'Operating Model'!S34`); writing the standard formula `='Operating Model'!S32*(1+J5)/(J4-J5)` produces the exact same value (`3952.51906024644`) but fails `_formulas_match`. (2) In `Supporting Schedules!N98`, `gt_06_golden.xlsx` has `=N96/'Revenue Build'!J33` (`0.457633186584176`), whereas `F98:I98` in the same row use `=1/'Operating Model'!F4*'Supporting Schedules'!F96`..`=1/'Operating Model'!I4*'Supporting Schedules'!I96` and `'Operating Model'!J4` equals `='Revenue Build'!J33` (`874.281`); writing `=N96/'Operating Model'!J4` or `=1/'Revenue Build'!J33*N96` yields the identical value but fails `_formulas_match`. (3) In `DCF!E11` (`(+) Cash`, where input had `-1035.4`), `gt_06_golden.xlsx` has `=BS!N20` (`926`), whereas `'BS Ann'!F20` holds the exact same Sep-28-2025 Total Cash & ST Investments figure (`926`) and `='BS'!N20` or `=BS!N18+BS!N19` also evaluate to `926` but fail string matching. Consequently, all 3 units failed the modification check (`0.5714` on units 1 and 2, `0.4286` on unit 3) and scored 0.0.
confirmation: spec mode='formula' with _normalize_formula only stripping $, case and '=+'. The GT J6 formula carries redundant DCF! qualifiers, and N98 is "=N96/'Revenue Build'!J33". Equivalent fixes like (1+J5)/(J4-J5) failed as modification errors in all trials of run <id>.
fix: Same J6 GT patch removes the confirmed false negative. Partial: alternative but equivalent sources for N98 ('Operating Model'!J4 vs 'Revenue Build'!J33) and E11 ('BS Ann'!F20 vs BS!N20) still need exact text, because formula mode only normalises '$', case and '=+' in the verifier code, which no parameter can change.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells fails all units (score=0) by rejecting equivalent formulas on modification cells and penalizing fixes to genuine bugs in gt_06_golden.xlsx
evidence: Across all 3 units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) returned `score=0`: unit 1 got `regression 0.9646, modification 0.5714 (478 cell errors)`, unit 2 got `regression 0.9613, modification 0.5714 (522 cell errors)`, and unit 3 got `regression 1.0000, modification 0.4286 (29 cell errors)`. Trajectory inspection shows that all 3 units properly audited the workbook and fixed both target hardcodes and real formula errors in the workbook: e.g., all 3 units fixed `#NAME?` errors at `Revenue Build!AC41` and `AC43` (`=rri(5,W41,AA41)` -> `=(AA41/W41)^(1/5)-1`) and fixed the broken sum at `Revenue Build!S9` (`=S13` -> `=SUM(S13,S21)` to match `J9:R9`); unit 3 also fixed the missing negative sign on taxes at `Operating Model!J25:L25` (`=IF(J23>0,$D$26*J23,0)` -> `=-IF(J23>0,$D$26*J23,0)` to match `M25:S25`); and units 1 and 2 replaced the 338 stale hardcoded floats in the `DCF!N13:Z25` and `DCF!N31:Z43` sensitivity tables with live formulas. Furthermore, on the 7 modification cells, units wrote mathematically identical formulas such as `='Operating Model'!S32*(1+J5)/(J4-J5)` in `DCF!J6` (seen in unit 3 step [95]), which `_formulas_match` marked wrong solely because `gt_06_golden.xlsx` includes redundant same-sheet `DCF!` prefixes (`='Operating Model'!S32*(1+DCF!J5)/(DCF!J4-DCF!J5)`).
confirmation: Re-scoring the 3 run outputs reproduces failures on equivalent formulas. DCF!J6 "='Operating Model'!S32*(1+J5)/(J4-J5)" is rejected against the GT's "...(1+DCF!J5)/(DCF!J4-DCF!J5)" in every trial, because formula mode only strips '$', case and '=+'.
